note: Small owner-run campground in the Lincoln Lakes region, village of Lee; RV + tent + cabins, wooded, with a wedding and event pavilion. ATV and snowmobile trails from the site; Silver Lake's public beach under a mile away. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40; added 30 amp, 36-ft limit, W/E only, showers, dump, wifi, phone booking, military 10%. Sites 8->9 (6 RV + 3 wilderness on the map). Season corrected to Memorial Day-Columbus Day weekends. Phone is wrong.
flags: PHONE WRONG: stored 207-738-3148; operator's whole site and Google give 207-608-1966. apply.py doesn't write phone.

GATE: $40 posted on the operator's page (2026 footer), passes. RV Life camper paid $40 on a Motorhome in 6/2026 and $38 in 6/2024. No Good Sam status known (not found under this name). RV Life 'discount none'. Presence: working site with phone.

REVIEWS: Google 4.9 from 78 reviews; RV Life 3 reviews all rated 10, $$. Quoted: Google: 'Reviews focus on the cabins. The campsites are bare minimum. Friendly staff but the main focus of this place is the wedding venue. Unfortunately if your plans change or someone is ill no refunds given'. Same list: 'Wonderful quiet little campground, the owners were amazing'. RV Life 6/2024: 'the park has 6 RV sites avail and 3 or 4 amazing log cabins'.

SITE COUNT: only 6 of the 9 take an RV (the map's yellow sites), which matches the RV Life reviewer. Wilderness sites are 'Perfect for tents and self-contained campers' on the rates page, but the map draws them on a footpath, so I based the fee on $40. If you read those as drive-in, the low is $30.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Wooded and on no water; 'a public beach under a mile away'.
PIN: stored 45.34154,-68.30632 sits on Arab Road at the entrance; the office and sites are ~100 m south/southeast on imagery. Within tolerance.
WEDDINGS: an events venue with Saturday bean-hole dinners and live bluegrass, per the operator. Not a criteria issue, worth knowing on a Saturday.
